openQuestions.text: What exact API endpoints, methods, payload schemas, response schemas, and error payload formats should be used?
What is the authoritative list of:
supported market codes
supported product type / mixture classification codes beyond those named here
configured EC number format
What exact CAS validation pattern should be enforced?
Is substance function a free-text field or controlled vocabulary?
For substance origin, should API accept display values, canonical uppercase enum values, or both?
Are finished product classification, rinse-off cosmetic classification, and formulation indicator separate fields, separate facets, or part of one normalized classification model?
What exact assessment lifecycle states correspond to:
setup completion
section complete
finalization of a substance entry
final assessment submission
What exact UI should be used for:
import summary display
compositional breakdown expansion
targeted incomplete raw material error messaging
Should duplicate impurity records for the same product/identity be rejected, merged, or versioned?
Is nano-material presence stored at assessment level, product composition level, or both with mapping?
Are concentration ranges editable anywhere, or only displayed when present in imported data?
For import, what file types/content types/size limits are supported?
Are non-blocking import warnings required in the first release, and if so, what warning categories exist?
What retention/history rules apply to audit metadata and import traceability records?
What role matrix governs read access across the actors beyond the explicitly stated write permissions?

userStories.title: As a Regulatory Assessor, I want to classify ABCD Shampoo as a rinse-off cosmetic product so that cosmetic regulatory evaluation uses the correct product type
As a Regulatory Assessor, I want to classify ABCD Shampoo as a chemical mixture so that mixture-based regulatory evaluation is supported
As a Global Compliance Manager, I want to record ABCD Shampoo as a finished consumer product placed on multiple global markets so that market-specific compliance evaluation can be performed
As a Formulation Specialist, I want to define ABCD Shampoo as a formulation composed of multiple raw materials and substances so that compositional assessment can trace all contributing components
As a Regulatory Data Steward, I want to document the complete ingredient list using INCI names so that the finished product record uses the required ingredient naming standard
As a Regulatory Data Steward, I want to document the CAS number for each substance so that each substance in the finished product can be uniquely identified
As a Regulatory Data Steward, I want to document the EC number where applicable so that each substance record includes applicable regulatory identifiers
As a Regulatory Assessor, I want to document the function of each substance so that the regulatory assessment record explains the role of every substance in the finished product
As a Formulation Specialist, I want to document the concentration percentage of each substance so that the final product composition is quantitatively defined
As a Regulatory Assessor, I want to document impurities at or above 0.1% so that reportable impurity presence is available for compliance evaluation
As a Regulatory Assessor, I want to document nano-material presence so that the finished product record reflects whether nano-materials are present
As a Regulatory Data Steward, I want to document the origin of each substance as synthetic, natural, or botanical so that substance sourcing classification is available for assessment
As a Compliance Analyst, I want to import product composition data into a single regulatory assessment record so that all required composition fields are available for compliance evaluation
As a Compliance Analyst, I want the imported record to include all required substance attributes so that the regulatory assessment can be completed without missing composition fields

As a Regulatory Assessor, I want the full compositional breakdown of all substances to be available for regulatory assessment so that compliance evaluation can review complete product composition evidence
